# Wadi Al Awir Car Accessories

> Bilingual car accessory catalogue and installation enquiries for Jetour T2, ROX 01 and ROX Adamas in Al Awir, Dubai, UAE.

## Business information

- Name: Wadi Al Awir Car Accessories / وادي العوير لزينة السيارات
- Location: Al Awir 1, Dubai, UAE
- Phone: +971 55 357 3156 and +971 58 179 6614
- Hours: 9 AM to 11 PM daily
- Instagram: @wadi_alawir
- Languages: English and Arabic

## Catalogue

The catalogue includes vehicle-specific exterior, interior, lighting and practical accessories. Each product page identifies its listed vehicle compatibility, price, images and available product details. Availability and final fit should be confirmed with the Wadi Al Awir team before installation.

## Services

The shop lists window tinting, paint protection film, ceramic coating, car detailing and custom accessory services. Current packages, suitability and availability can be confirmed through WhatsApp or at the Al Awir shop.

## Ordering

Orders and product enquiries are handled through WhatsApp. The website does not operate a conventional online checkout.
